🎉🎉🎉 LORNA VILLARUZ IS COMING TO LIVERPOOL!!! 🎉🎉🎉

Yes, you are reading that right. My best friend is coming to work in England!! After 20 years of me telling her to come, she has finally listened to me haha. Actually she agreed in 2004, she just took her sweet time, no apology to anyone 😂

@Lorna Villaruz — Lorna Villaruz, my best friend since 1996. Iloilo, nursing school, the capping ceremony. Look at that photo again, same hairstyle, same white shoes we polished every night in the dorm. And you know what, you polished yours with MY polish and never once bought your own bottle. Shameless 😂 Those shoes never looked as good as they did that night, and neither did we, mga anak!

Then Riyadh, then Dubai, almost 18 years of shifts and heat and missing home, and you never stopped studying. Two years of papers, IELTS, CBT, and the OSCE in Nottingham. When you were nervous I sent you a photo of the rain so you knew what you were getting into 🌧️ Welcome to English weather, bestie!

And today, 9 November, your PIN number came through!!! 🙏 You are a registered nurse in the UK, Lorna!! I cried at the clinic, I am so happy I cannot even type properly. 22 years a midwife in this city and now my own best friend is finally here, working in the same hospital trust I do. The girls in the clinic are fed up with me today haha.

The details, because she made me put them:
✈️ Lands 14 January, Dubai to Manchester, around 1pm.
🏥 Starts 25 January on Ward 7, medical, Mersey Bank Hospital — induction first, then your preceptorship.
🏠 First month she stays with us, in the spare room. Ben says ok. Ben has said ok before I even asked him, he is already excited about the Bicol pili 😂 And bring the dried mangoes, ha, don't forget the dried mangoes.

Lorna, you are the best nurse I know. Calm when everything around you is chaos, kind to the frightened patients, and they already love you — they just don't know it yet. Ward 7 has no idea how lucky it is. You will walk in there and they will wonder where you have been hiding all these years.

One instruction from me, and I am serious: bring a PROPER coat. Not the Divisoria one. A proper coat, a warm scarf, gloves, boots you can run in. Liverpool wind is no joke, it will take your hat off before it takes your breath. You will not survive one January without a proper coat, I am telling you now.

And welcome to our Filipino family here, Lorna!! The Christmas parties, the potluck at St Teresa's with Jun and the raffle tickets, the karaoke, the food going cold because we all talk at once, the noise, the laughter, the Christmas Mass — welcome to all of it. And Simbang Gabi next year, nine nights, 6pm, you will be with us. You will cry at the first one, I promise, and Ben will hand you a bib 😂

I love you, best friend. 30 years of friendship and it still feels like yesterday, two 21-year-olds shining white shoes and dreaming about England. Now pack your bags and come home to Liverpool.

Mabuhay ka, Lorna! 🇵🇭❤️

Charing!!! Of course you stay with us the first month, the spare room is yours, no question. Ben said ok straight away haha, he is already looking forward to the Bicol pili and the dried mangoes. I have cleared Andrea's boxes out (sorry anak, your stuff is stacked in the hallway 😂), thick duvet on the bed, heater ready, and I am buying you a proper coat from TK Maxx before you land, because I know you, and I know what you will pack. Bring gloves and a scarf too.

See you 14 January, 1pm at Manchester. I am so proud of you, I love you, and I am not telling anyone at work that my best friend is coming 😂❤️
